svg.title: Distributed Tracing
svg.desc: Distributed Tracing. Propagate a trace context across services and assemble the spans into one timeline. Step 1, Start a trace: The gateway starts trace 4bf92f… and a root span, and adds a traceparent header to its call. Step 2, Propagate context: Each call opens a child span with the same trace ID, a new span ID and the caller as its parent. Step 3, Export spans: As spans end, each service exports them in batches, out of band, to the collector. Step 4, Find the bottleneck: The backend assembles the waterfall: Payments takes 180 ms of the 240 ms request.

g.text: The gateway starts trace 4bf92f… and a root span, and adds a traceparent header to its call.
Each call opens a child span with the same trace ID, a new span ID and the caller as its parent.
As spans end, each service exports them in batches, out of band, to the collector.
The backend assembles the waterfall: Payments takes 180 ms of the 240 ms request.
Payments: 180 ms of the 240 ms request (75%)
